title: Norway considers ban on camera-enabled wearable 'pervert glasses' | TechCrunch
summary: These wearables feature cameras, are internet-connected, and may soon include facial recognition , drawing ire from civil liberties advocates, who say the devices intrude on people’s privacy. Some call the devices “pervert glasses,” prompting considerable consumer backlash.
